verdict.rationale: Temporal supports workflow versioning behavior (Pinned/Auto-Upgrade) and worker versioning, plus Web UI for inspecting execution state/history, which gives some review/debugging capability, but there is no evidence of a UI-driven or automatic 'roll back an automation' feature or version diffing/review workflow tailored for AI-native automation authors — this is developer-centric code versioning, not a no-code review/rollback UX. missing for 10: explicit rollback mechanism for workflow versions, a review/diff UI for comparing automation versions, and AI-native (non-developer) tooling for reverting a running automation to a prior version.
